ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider (Octo Tempest) help-desk-driven MFA reset → new-device Entra sign-in within 30m
ucs.description: Hunts Scattered Spider's signature initial-access chain: a vished IT help-desk technician resets a target's MFA methods / password, followed minutes later by an interactive Entra ID sign-in from a previously unseen device/IP for that user. UNC3944's intrusion playbook leans almost entirely on this fast pivot rather than malware.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as resetTime values(Change.src) as resetSrc values(Change.user) as helpdeskActor from datamodel=Change where (Change.action=modified OR Change.action=updated) AND (Change.object_category=user OR Change.object_category=authentication) AND (Change.change_type=AAD OR Change.change_type=identity OR Change.change_type=Okta) AND (Change.object IN ("StrongAuthenticationMethod","StrongAuthenticationUserDetails","AuthenticatorAppContextState","PhoneAuthenticationPhoneNumber","resetPassword","user.mfa.factor.reset_all","user.account.reset_password")) by Change.result Change.user Change.object _time span=1m | rename Change.user as target_user Change.object as resetAction | eval resetWindowEnd=resetTime+1800 | join type=inner target_user [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as signInTime values(Authentication.src) as signInSrc values(Authentication.user_agent) as ua values(Authentication.signature) as auth_app from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success AND Authentication.app IN ("Microsoft Entra ID","Azure Active Directory","AzureActiveDirectory","Okta") AND Authentication.authentication_method!="Previously satisfied" by Authentication.user _time span=1m | rename Authentication.user as target_user] | where signInTime >= resetTime AND signInTime <= resetWindowEnd AND resetSrc!=signInSrc | stats min(resetTime) as resetTime min(signInTime) as signInTime values(helpdeskActor) as helpdeskActor values(resetAction) as resetAction values(resetSrc) as resetSrc values(signInSrc) as signInSrc values(ua) as ua values(auth_app) as auth_app by target_user | eval delaySec=signInTime-resetTime | where delaySec < 1800 | convert ctime(resetTime) ctime(signInTime)
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSeconds = 1800; // 30 min — empirical UNC3944 hand-off window from vished reset to attacker logon
let MfaResets = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Application in~ ("Microsoft Azure Active Directory","Office 365","Microsoft Entra ID","Okta")
    | where ActionType has_any ("Reset user password","Reset password (by admin)","Update user","User registered security info","Admin registered security info","Admin deleted security info","Reset all factors","user.mfa.factor.reset_all","user.account.reset_password")
    | extend TargetUpn = tostring(parse_json(tostring(ActivityObjects))[0].Name)
    | where isnotempty(TargetUpn)
    | project ResetTime = Timestamp, HelpdeskActor = AccountDisplayName, HelpdeskUpn = AccountObjectId, ResetAction = ActionType, ResetIP = IPAddress, TargetUpn;
MfaResets
| join kind=inner (
    AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ErrorCode == 0 and IsInteractive == true
    | project SignInTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, SignInIP = IPAddress, Country, DeviceTrustType, AadDeviceId, Browser, UserAgent, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, ApplicationId
  ) on $left.TargetUpn == $right.AccountUpn
| where SignInTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| where ResetIP != SignInIP
| where DeviceTrustType in ("", "Unknown") or isempty(AadDeviceId)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', SignInTime, ResetTime)
| project ResetTime, SignInTime, DelaySec, TargetUpn, HelpdeskActor, ResetAction, ResetIP, SignInIP, Country, DeviceTrustType, Browser, UserAgent, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
| order by ResetTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSeconds = 1800; // 30 min — empirical UNC3944 hand-off window
let MfaResets = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OperationName in ("Reset user password","Reset password (by admin)","Update user","User registered security info","Admin registered security info","Admin deleted security info","User registered security info")
    | extend TargetUpn = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
    | extend HelpdeskUpn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | extend ResetIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | where isnotempty(TargetUpn)
    | project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, HelpdeskUpn, ResetAction = OperationName, ResetIP, TargetUpn;
MfaResets
| join kind=inner (
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ResultType == 0 and IsInteractive == true
    | extend DeviceTrust = tostring(DeviceDetail.trustType), DeviceId = tostring(DeviceDetail.deviceId), Browser = tostring(DeviceDetail.browser)
    | project SignInTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, SignInIP = IPAddress, Location, DeviceTrust, DeviceId, Browser, UserAgent, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, AppDisplayName
  ) on $left.TargetUpn == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where SignInTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| where ResetIP != SignInIP
| where DeviceTrust in ("","Unknown") or isempty(DeviceId)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', SignInTime, ResetTime)
| project ResetTime, SignInTime, DelaySec, TargetUpn, HelpdeskUpn, ResetAction, ResetIP, SignInIP, Location, DeviceTrust, Browser, UserAgent, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, AppDisplayName
| order by ResetTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:okta @evt.name:(user.mfa.factor.reset_all OR user.account.reset_password OR user.mfa.factor.deactivate OR user.account.update_password)) OR (source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:("Reset user password" OR "Reset password (by admin)" OR "User registered security info" OR "Admin registered security info"))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog (EventName=/reset_password|reset_all|registered\s+security/i OR OperationName=/Reset (user )?password|Update user|registered security info/i)
| join({#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog EventOutcome=Success EventName=/sign[-_ ]?in|user\.session\.start/i}, field=[TargetUserPrincipalName], include=[EventTime, SourceIP, UserAgent, DeviceTrustType])
| ResetIP!=SourceIP
| DeviceTrustType=/^(|Unknown)$/i
| groupBy([TargetUserPrincipalName, EventTime], function=[count(), min(EventTime, as=ResetTime), max(EventTime, as=SignInTime)])
| DelaySec := SignInTime - ResetTime
| DelaySec < 1800
ucs.rationale: This is the textbook 0ktapus / Octo Tempest / UNC3944 initial-access chain documented by Microsoft, Mandiant and CrowdStrike: vish the help desk, get MFA/password reset, log in from attacker infrastructure within minutes. Tying the reset event to a subsequent interactive sign-in from a different IP on an unenrolled / untrusted device — within a 30-minute window — collapses the noise of normal pass

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider RMM-tool fleet drop (Splashtop / ScreenConnect / AnyDesk / Pulseway / ngrok) after fresh interactive logon
ucs.description: Hunts Scattered Spider's hallmark hands-on-keyboard persistence: installation or first-execution of legitimate RMM agents (Splashtop, ScreenConnect/ConnectWise Control, AnyDesk, TeamViewer, Pulseway, ngrok, Tactical RMM, Level.io, Action1) on a host that just received an interactive logon, frequently dropped into a user profile path. UNC3944 famously avoids custom malware and instead lives on these tools — Microsoft / CISA AA23-320A explicitly call out this fleet.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as firstSeen values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.process_path) as image from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("Splashtop.exe","SRService.exe","SRManager.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ConnectWiseControl.ClientService.exe","AnyDesk.exe","TeamViewer.exe","TeamViewer_Service.exe","Pulseway.exe","PCMonitorSrv.exe","ngrok.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","MeshAgent.exe","LMI Ignition.exe","Action1_agent.exe","rport.exe","FleetDeck.exe","Atera.exe","AteraAgent.exe","Level.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*\\AppData\\*\\AnyDesk*","*\\Users\\Public\\*ngrok*","*Splashtop*-install*","*ScreenConnect.ClientSetup*") by host Processes.process_name Processes.user Processes.dest | rename Processes.process_name as rmm_tool Processes.user as logon_user Processes.dest as dest | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true max(_time) as logonTime values(Authentication.user) as logon_user values(Authentication.src) as logon_src from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success AND Authentication.authentication_method IN ("Interactive","RemoteInteractive","NetworkInteractive") by host | rename Authentication.dest as host] | where firstSeen >= logonTime AND (firstSeen-logonTime) < 7200 | stats values(rmm_tool) as rmm_tools dc(rmm_tool) as tool_count values(cmdline) as cmdlines values(image) as image values(parent) as parent values(logon_src) as logon_src by host logon_user firstSeen logonTime | where tool_count >= 1 | eval install_delay_sec=firstSeen-logonTime | convert ctime(firstSeen) ctime(logonTime)
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic(["splashtop.exe","srservice.exe","srmanager.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.clientservice.exe","anydesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","pulseway.exe","pcmonitorsrv.exe","ngrok.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","meshagent.exe","lmi ignition.exe","action1_agent.exe","rport.exe","fleetdeck.exe","ateraagent.exe","level.exe"]);
let RmmInstallNames = dynamic(["splashtop-streamer.exe","connectwisecontrol.clientsetup.exe","screenconnect.clientsetup.exe","anydesk-installer.exe","teamviewer_setup.exe","meshcentral_install.exe"]);
let InteractiveLogons = DeviceLogonEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
    | where LogonType in ("Interactive","RemoteInteractive","CachedInteractive")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$" and AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | summarize LogonTime = max(Timestamp), LogonSrc = any(RemoteIP) by DeviceId, AccountUpn = InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, AccountName;
let RmmExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (RmmBinaries) or FileName in~ (RmmInstallNames)
        or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("splashtop-streamer","ScreenConnect.ClientSetup","AnyDesk.exe --install","AnyDesk-installer","Pulseway.msi","ngrok.exe tcp","ngrok.exe http","meshcentral")
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\", @"\Temp\", @"\Downloads\")
        or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("msiexec.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, RmmTool = FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, AccountName, AccountUpn;
RmmExec
| join kind=inner InteractiveLogons on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (LogonTime .. LogonTime + 2h)
| extend InstallDelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, LogonTime)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), Tools = make_set(RmmTool), ToolCount = dcount(RmmTool), Cmdlines = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 5), Parent = any(InitiatingProcessFileName), Paths = make_set(FolderPath) by DeviceName, AccountName, LogonSrc, LogonTime, InstallDelaySec
| where ToolCount >= 1
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic(["splashtop.exe","srservice.exe","srmanager.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.clientservice.exe","anydesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","pulseway.exe","pcmonitorsrv.exe","ngrok.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","meshagent.exe","action1_agent.exe","rport.exe","ateraagent.exe","level.exe"]);
let InteractiveLogons = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4624 and LogonType in (2,10,11)
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$" and TargetUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE","ANONYMOUS LOGON")
    | summarize LogonTime = max(TimeGenerated), LogonSrc = any(IpAddress) by Computer, AccountName = TargetUserName;
let RmmExec = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend FileName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where FileName in (RmmBinaries)
        or NewProcessName has_any ("splashtop-streamer","ScreenConnect.ClientSetup","AnyDesk-installer","meshcentral")
        or CommandLine has_any ("splashtop-streamer","ScreenConnect.ClientSetup","AnyDesk.exe --install","AnyDesk-installer","Pulseway.msi","ngrok.exe tcp","ngrok.exe http")
    | where NewProcessName has_any (@"\Users\", @"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\", @"\Temp\", @"\Downloads\")
        or ParentProcessName has_any ("msiexec.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, RmmTool = FileName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, AccountName = SubjectUserName;
RmmExec
| join kind=inner InteractiveLogons on Computer
| where TimeGenerated between (LogonTime .. LogonTime + 2h)
| extend InstallDelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, LogonTime)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), Tools = make_set(RmmTool), ToolCount = dcount(RmmTool), Cmdlines = make_set(CommandLine, 5), Parent = any(ParentProcessName) by Computer, AccountName, LogonSrc, LogonTime, InstallDelaySec
| where ToolCount >= 1
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Scattered Spider RMM-tool fleet execution from user-writable path
id: 9a8c2f4d-3b7e-4e11-9bde-rmm-fleet-uncscatter
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of legitimate RMM tools (Splashtop, ScreenConnect, AnyDesk, TeamViewer, Pulseway, ngrok, Action1, Atera, Level.io, MeshAgent, ngrok, Tactical RMM) from non-standard / user-writable paths — hallmark Scattered Spider (UNC3944 / Octo Tempest) hands-on-keyboard persistence.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-320a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2023/10/25/octo-tempest-crosses-boundaries-to-facilitate-extortion-encryption-and-destruction/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/13
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1219.002
  - attack.t1133
  - g1015
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\Splashtop.exe'
      - '\SRService.exe'
      - '\SRManager.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
      - '\ConnectWiseControl.ClientService.exe'
      - '\AnyDesk.exe'
      - '\TeamViewer.exe'
      - '\TeamViewer_Service.exe'
      - '\Pulseway.exe'
      - '\PCMonitorSrv.exe'
      - '\ngrok.exe'
      - '\tacticalrmm.exe'
      - '\MeshAgent.exe'
      - '\Action1_agent.exe'
      - '\rport.exe'
      - '\AteraAgent.exe'
      - '\Level.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Public\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\Downloads\'
  selection_install:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'splashtop-streamer'
      - 'ScreenConnect.ClientSetup'
      - 'AnyDesk.exe --install'
      - 'AnyDesk-installer'
      - 'ngrok.exe tcp'
      - 'ngrok.exe http'
  condition: (selection_image and selection_path) or selection_install
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned IT support tooling — baseline against approved RMM inventory and exclude install paths under Program Files.
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:(4688 OR 1)) (@Image:(*\\Splashtop.exe OR *\\splashtop.exe OR *\\SRService.exe OR *\\srservice.exe OR *\\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\\screenconnect.clientservice.exe OR *\\AnyDesk.exe OR *\\anydesk.exe OR *\\TeamViewer.exe OR *\\teamviewer.exe OR *\\Pulseway.exe OR *\\pulseway.exe OR *\\ngrok.exe OR *\\NGROK.EXE OR *\\AteraAgent.exe OR *\\ateraagent.exe OR *\\MeshAgent.exe OR *\\meshagent.exe OR *\\Action1_agent.exe OR *\\action1_agent.exe OR *\\Level.exe OR *\\level.exe OR *\\rport.exe OR *\\RPort.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*splashtop-streamer* OR *ScreenConnect.ClientSetup* OR *"AnyDesk.exe --install"* OR *AnyDesk-installer* OR *"ngrok.exe tcp"* OR *"ngrok.exe http"*)) (@Image:(*\\Users\\* OR *\\AppData\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\Public\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\Downloads\\*) OR @ParentImage:(*\\msiexec.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 (ImageFileName=/\\(splashtop|srservice|srmanager|screenconnect\.clientservice|screenconnect\.windowsclient|connectwisecontrol\.clientservice|anydesk|teamviewer|teamviewer_service|pulseway|pcmonitorsrv|ngrok|tacticalrmm|meshagent|action1_agent|rport|ateraagent|level)\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/splashtop-streamer|screenconnect\.clientsetup|anydesk.*--install|anydesk-installer|ngrok\.exe (tcp|http)|pulseway\.msi|meshcentral/i)
| ImageFileName=/\\(Users|AppData|ProgramData|Public|Temp|Downloads)\\/i OR ParentBaseFileName=/(msiexec|powershell|pwsh|cmd|curl|certutil|bitsadmin)\.exe$/i
| join({#event_simpleName=UserLogon LogonType=/^(2|10|11)$/}, field=aid, include=[LogonTime, RemoteAddressIP4, UserName], mode=left)
| InstallDelaySec := @timestamp - LogonTime
| InstallDelaySec >= 0
| InstallDelaySec < 7200
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(as=Executions), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, RemoteAddressIP4], limit=20)])
ucs.rationale: CISA AA23-320A, Microsoft (Octo Tempest), Mandiant (UNC3944) and CrowdStrike (Scattered Spider) all converge on the same tradecraft: post-initial-access, the operators install a *fleet* of legitimate RMM tools (Splashtop, ScreenConnect, AnyDesk, Pulseway, ngrok, Tactical RMM, Action1, Atera, Level.io, MeshCentral) for resilient hands-on-keyboard access, rather than dropping custom implants.
